title: GIMS Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 100 Staff Nurse posts
description: The Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 100 Staff Nurse Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.Sc Nursing or GNM can use this chance and apply for the GIMS Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, applciation fee, and how to apply for these posts.
